description: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts so the existing post-land test-suite check also runs as a PRE-cutover gate. Today resolveTestSuite runs only AFTER the commit lands, at around line 2311; its failing-test names are diffed against the per-vessel baseline under /workspace/post-land-baseline/ and a substrateGap is filed for newly-failing tests. That per-test attribution logic is correct and must be reused, not duplicated. Before promoting the mitosis track, run the same suite against the mitosis tree, compute the same newly-failing set difference against the vessel baseline, and refuse the cutover when that set is non-empty and the same tests still fail on a confirming re-run. Keep the existing post-land observation path unchanged as the fallback for when the pre-cutover run cannot execute.
